decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: Tests observe the established README contract without creating or changing an exported API or supported external contract.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go test code benefits from idiomatic names, simple helpers, explicit errors, state ownership and formatting.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No production interface, dependency wiring, constructor or resource-lifecycle decision changes; fixture ownership is covered by test-isolation guidance.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing external test package and production package retain their responsibilities and import direction.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: Tests use handwritten HTTP transports, tracked response bodies, local HTTP servers, concurrent workers, cancellation events and parallel subtests. The reference covers fixture boundary selection, focused leaf execution, cleanup and Go 1.22 timing.
